plan: [Truthful bidding is weakly dominant in a second-price (Vickrey) auction: you win when your value exceeds others' bids and you pay the second-highest. Values are independent and redrawn, with no history to exploit. To maximize expected long-run profit, submit your true value bid of 9.0.]

[In a second-price auction, the dominant strategy is to bid my true private value to maximize expected profit. No prior history to exploit; ties resolved randomly. I will bid my value $9.0 exactly, ensuring I win whenever second-highest bid <9 and pay that price, yielding positive surplus when possible.]

[This is a second-price sealed-bid auction with three bidders. Truthful bidding is a (weakly) dominant strategy: bid your private value to maximize expected long-run profit. Bidding above $34 risks negative payoff if you win and pay more than your value; bidding below $34 risks missing positive-profit wins. With discrete $0.1 steps and no history, submit bid = $34.]
